channel.title: Malawi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Malawi, every source cited.

item.title: Malawi U-15 team finishes 79th at Fifa World Cup
item.description: The team's performance in Baku exposed significant gaps in the nation's youth football development structures.

item.title: Malawi parliament meeting postponed after presidential recommendation
item.description: President Mutharika recommended postponing the National Assembly's session, with the Speaker announcing the change.

item.title: Mutharika returns, blames fuel and power issues on saboteurs
item.description: President Peter Mutharika stated he was in full control of Malawi during his absence and promised consequences for electricity disruptions.

item.title: Malawi expands cancer treatment services
item.description: Kamuzu Central Hospital registered over 2,100 new cancer patients in 2025, offering chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

item.title: Malawi central bank raises borrowing costs
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Malawi increased its Lombard Rate to 2 percent to manage liquidity amid inflation risks.
